sn16.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākassapo rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn16.11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
sn16.11:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato ānandassa tiṃsamattā saddhivihārino bhikkhū sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattā bhavanti yebhuyyena kumārabhūtā.
sn16.11:2.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ yathābhirantaṃ cārikaṃ caritvā yena rājagahaṃ veḷuvanaṃ kalandakanivāpaṃ yenāyasmā mahākassapo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āyasmā mahākassapo etadavoca
sn16.11:2.3: kati nu kho āvuso ānanda atthavase paṭicca bhagavatā kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññattanti.
sn16.11:3.1: tayo kho bhante kassapa atthavase paṭicca bhagavatā kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññattaṃ
sn16.11:3.2: dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya mā pāpicchā pakkhaṃ nissāya saṅghaṃ bhindeyyuṃ kulānudayatāya ca
sn16.11:3.3: ime kho bhante kassapa tayo atthavase paṭicca bhagavatā kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññattanti.
sn16.11:4.1: atha kiñcarahi tvaṃ āvuso ānanda imehi bhikkhūhi indriyesu aguttadvārehi bhojane amattaññūhi jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttehi saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carasi
sn16.11:4.2: sassaghātaṃ maññe carasi kulappaghātaṃ 3 maññe carasi
sn16.11:4.3: olujjati kho te āvuso ānanda parisā
sn16.11:4.4: palujjanti kho te āvuso ānanda navappāyā
sn16.11:5.1: api me bhante kassapa sirasmiṃ palitāni jātāni
sn16.11:5.2: atha ca pana mayaṃ ajjāpi āyasmato mahākassapassa kumārakavādā na muccāmāti.
sn16.11:5.3: tathā hi pana tvaṃ āvuso ānanda imehi navehi bhikkhūhi indriyesu aguttadvārehi bhojane amattaññūhi jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttehi saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carasi sassaghātaṃ maññe carasi kulappaghātaṃ maññe carasi
sn16.11:5.4: olujjati kho te āvuso ānanda parisā
sn16.11:6.2: ayyena kira mahā kassapena ayyo ānando vedehamuni kumārakavādena apasāditoti.
sn16.11:7.1: atha kho thullanandā bhikkhunī anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi
sn16.11:7.2: kiṃ pana ayyo mahākassapo aññatitthiyapubbo samāno ayyaṃ ānandaṃ vedehamuniṃ kumārakavādena apasādetabbaṃ maññatīti.
sn16.11:7.3: assosi kho āyasmā mahākassapo thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā imaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānāya.
sn16.11:8.1: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
sn16.11:8.2: tagghāvuso ānanda thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā sahasā appaṭisaṅkhā vācā bhāsitā
sn16.11:8.3: yatohaṃ āvuso kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito nābhijānāmi aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddisitā aññatra tena bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena.
sn16.11:8.4: pubbe me āvuso āgārikabhūtassa sato etadahosi
sn16.11:8.6: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ
sn16.11:8.7: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti.
sn16.11:8.8: so khvāhaṃ āvuso aparena samayena paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ karitvā ye loke arahanto te uddissa kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ
sn16.11:9.1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno addhānamaggaṃ paṭipanno addasaṃ bhagavantaṃ antarā ca rājagahaṃ antarā ca nāḷandaṃ bahupa ุttacetiye nisinnaṃ
sn16.11:9.4: sugatañca vatāhaṃ passeyyaṃ bhagavanta meva passeyyaṃ
sn16.11:9.7: so khvāhaṃ āvuso tattheva bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocaṃ
sn16.11:9.10: evaṃ vutte maṃ āvuso bhagavā etadavoca
sn16.11:9.11: yo kho kassapa evaṃ sabbacetaso samannāhataṃ sāvakaṃ ajānaññeva vadeyya jānāmīti apassaññeva vadeyya passāmīti muddhāpi tassa vipateyya.
sn16.11:9.12: ahaṃ kho pana kassapa jānaññeva vadāmi jānāmīti passaññeva vadāmi passāmīti.
sn16.11:10.2: tibbaṃ me hirottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ bhavissati theresu navesu majjhimesūti
sn16.11:11.2: yaṅkañci dhammaṃ suṇissāmi kusalū pasañhitaṃ sabbantaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikaritvā sabbacetaso samannā haritvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇissāmīti
sn16.11:12.2: sātasahagatā ca me kāyagatāsati na vijahissatīti
sn16.11:13.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā iminā ovādena ova ditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
sn16.11:13.2: sattāhameva khohaṃ āvuso sāṇo raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjiṃ atha aṭṭhamiyā aññā udapādi.
sn16.11:14.1: atha kho āvuso bhagavā maggā okkamma yena aññataraṃ rukkhamūlaṃ tenu pasaṅkami.
sn16.11:14.2: atha khvāhaṃ āvuso paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ catugguṇaṃ paññapetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocaṃ
sn16.11:14.3: idha bhante bhagavā nisīdatu yaṃ mamassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
sn16.11:14.4: nisīdi kho āvuso bhagavā paññatte āsane.
sn16.11:14.5: nisajja kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā etadavoca
sn16.11:14.6: mudukā kho tyāyaṃ kassapa paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭīti.
sn16.11:14.7: paṭiggaṇhātu me bhante bhagavā paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn16.11:14.8: dhāressasi pana me tvaṃ kassapa sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānīti.
sn16.11:14.9: dhāressāmahaṃ bhante bhagavato sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānīti.
sn16.11:14.10: so khvāhaṃ āvuso paṭapilotikānaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ bhagavato pādāsiṃ
sn16.11:14.11: ahaṃ panassa bhagavato sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanāni paṭipajjiṃ.
sn16.11:15.1: yañhi taṃ āvuso sammā vadamāno vadeyya
sn16.11:15.2: bhagavato putto oraso mukhato jāto dhammajo dhammanimmito dhammadā yādo paṭiggahitāni sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānīti mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
sn16.11:15.3: bhagavato putto oraso mukhato jāto dhammajo dhammanimmito dhammadāyādo paṭiggahitāni sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanānīti.
sn16.11:16.1: ahaṃ kho āvuso yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn16.11:17.1: ahaṃ kho āvuso āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmi.
sn16.11:17.2: sattaratanaṃ vā so āvuso nāgaṃ aḍḍhaṭṭhamaratanaṃ vā tālapattikāya chādetabbaṃ maññeyya yo maṃ chahi abhiññāhi chādetabbaṃ maññeyyāti.
sn16.11:18.1: cavittha ca pana thullanandā bhikkhunī brahmacariyamhāti.
